    61→// column sidecars on all subnets. This method returns a nil map when there is no validators custody
    62→// requirement.
    63→func (s *Service) allDataColumnSubnets(_ primitives.Slot) map[uint64]bool {

    77→	dataColumnSidecarSubnetCount := params.BeaconConfig().DataColumnSidecarSubnetCount
